title: docc
body: docc is a compiler and linter for documentation written as JSON. It checks structure, links, content and style, and builds Markdown for people to read. ^qbzq
Start with [[document-model@76su]] to see what a document looks like, then [[agent-workflow@sf27]] for the loop an agent follows. ^72rr
